messages:
dan_customer: Hey team — our private deployment for tenant t-492 stopped showing any request metrics in the Console around 10:11 UTC. API traffic works, auth succeeds, but per-tenant charts show zeros since the auth swap. Can you help?

alice_support: thanks for flagging. Did you recently change the ingress or auth mode? any deploys or config flips around 10:00-10:15?

dan_customer: yes we switched the gateway from Bearer header auth to mTLS for that cluster at ~10:05. No app changes. Verified we can still call the API and responses are fine.

carla_engineer: digging into the ingress logs for the private cluster. I see requests coming in but the X-Redwood-Tenant header is absent after the new ingress rewrite. example extract:```
[2026-03-17T10:12:05Z] ingress-nginx GET /v1/generate host=private.example.com src=10.0.4.22 auth=mTLS authorization=(redacted) headers=(X-Forwarded-For, Authorization) 
# original client sent X-Redwood-Tenant: t-492 but ingress removed it during proxy pass
```

carla_engineer: downstream we see metrics events landing to kafka with tenant_id=null for that customer. quick check: SELECT count(*) FROM metrics WHERE tenant_id='t-492' AND ts > now() - interval '2 hours' -- returns 0.

bob_sre: that matches theory: ingress swap probably enabled a header whitelist or request proxy_set_header defaults that drop unknown headers. Quick workaround is to set an explicit annotation to forward the header. For nginx: nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant

bob_sre: you can patch the ingress like:```
kubectl -n private-ns patch ingress private-api -p '{"metadata": {"annotations": {"nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy_set_header": "X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant"}}}'
```

alice_support: carla/bob — can we try the patch on their cluster as a hotfix? It should be safe and revertible.

dan_customer: please go ahead, we can tolerate a brief restart of the ingress.

carla_engineer: applied the annotation and reloaded ingress at 10:18 UTC. Watching metrics pipeline...

carla_engineer: metrics for t-492 started appearing again ~10:21 UTC, there was ~3-4 min lag for the metrics to be visible in Console. Dan, can you confirm things look normal on your side?

dan_customer: confirmed. Charts repopulating, historical gap from 10:05-10:18 remains missing. thanks for the quick patch :tada: 

bob_sre: for long term we should: 1) add a regression test for header preservation when swapping auth modes, 2) ensure ingress helm values include a canonical list of headers to forward, 3) add a fallback in metrics pipeline to tag events with tenant from TLS cert SAN when header is missing (if available).

carla_engineer: filed ticket INF-7890 to track the follow-ups and data backfill request to backfill missing window for t-492. infra-bot created the ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-7890 created by carla_engineer: "Ingress auth swap dropped tenant header; metrics missing for t-492; hotfix applied; needs backfill + regression test."

alice_support: closing loop with customer. Dan, we'll follow up in INF-7890 with ETA for backfill. Anything else you need?

dan_customer: nope, that's perfect. thanks everyone.

carla_engineer: postmortem note: ingress auth changes can unintentionally change header propagation. we'll add a pre-switch checklist for production private clusters.
